name: template-context
body:
The execution context of a template is not only its field values and rendered body: every slide layout and every section template is also given a reserved data context — a `deck` entry with the deck-wide data (`title`, `author`, `date` and the author's `properties`), a `slide` entry with the current slide's derived metadata (the string position label `number` and the integer `total`), an `item` entry describing the current instance's place among its siblings (`index`, `number`, `count`, `first`, `last`, `section`, `template`, `depth`, `parent`; see item-context), a `raw` entry with the author's original source values (raw-source-context), a `data` entry with the authored section tree as data (section-data-context), and — for a body whose template declares the `tables` option — a `table` entry holding the body's first parsed table (nil when the body carries none) and a `tables` entry holding the body's parsed tables in source order (table-layout-context, gfm-tables). At slide level `item` is nil or absent. This is data carried alongside the field values, not a helper: `deck`, `slide`, `item`, `raw`, `data`, `table` and `tables` are data entries, not functions, and the helper set (`media`, `section`, `dict`, `list`, `child`, `children`) is independent of this context (template-language). `deck`, `slide`, `item`, `raw`, `data`, `table` and `tables` are reserved top-level names, unavailable as field or section names in a template (requirements.constraint.reserved-template-names, domain.constraint.template-context-reserved). The same context is present in a slide's layout and in every section instance's execution, at every composition depth.

AC: `{{.deck.title}}`, `{{.deck.author}}`, `{{.deck.date}}`, `{{index .deck.properties "audience"}}`, `{{.slide.number}}` (the string position label) / `{{.slide.total}}` (the integer total), `{{.raw.<field>}}`/`{{.raw.body}}`, `{{.data.<section>}}` and, in a table-accepting template, `{{.table}}`/`{{.tables}}` render from a slide layout and from a section template; the `{{.item.*}}` descriptor renders at every depth and is nil/absent in a slide layout; the `{{.item.depth}}` field carries the instance's self-nesting depth; loading a template that declares a field or section named `deck`, `slide`, `item`, `raw`, `data`, `table` or `tables` is a templates error.
